text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is recommending the approval of a designated on-street accessible loading zone located on the west side of Rushbrooke Avenue, between Queen Street East and Eastern Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible loading zone to operate from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., all days of week, on the west side of Rushbrooke Avenue, between a point 64 metres north of Eastern Avenue and a point 11 metres further north.
